pages.text: Two radios on one antenna's coax $(thing)overdraw$() it and neither hears a thing. Put an $(item)Antenna Splitter$() on the coax instead: coax from the antenna into one side, coax to each radio out of the others. Every radio behind it hears the antenna, each a little weaker the more there are.$(br2)It is $(thing)receive only$(): nothing can transmit through it. Give a transmitter its own antenna.
Four coax round an iron ingot.
